name: flipiq-batch
description: Query saved supplier-list analyses and analyze single Amazon products with FlipIQ Batch.

interface.longDescription: Explore saved FlipIQ Batch supplier-list analyses and analyze individual Amazon products through your connected account. Requires an existing account at flipiqbatch.com. Search and paginate catalogs, see list overviews, filter products using shared FlipIQ views, export a list's rows as CSV, and inspect account eligibility, measured sales sources, costs, warnings, and FBA/MFN economics. An interactive table supports filters, sorting, brand grouping, selection, and product details, with Markdown fallback. Review your single-product scan history and the products you watch. Distinguishes sellable products from those requiring approval and flags costs requiring confirmation. Reading saved data uses nothing from your plan. analizar_producto runs one live analysis with Amazon and Keepa market data, saves it to your scan history and uses one analysis from your plan, like the Analyze button on the website. No orders, list uploads, subscription changes, or saved cost edits. Access remains limited to authorized pilot accounts.
defaultPrompt: Show an interactive table for my latest supplier list.
Summarize sellable products and those needing approval.
Show products whose supplier cost needs checking.

prompts: Find my analyzed supplier lists and show the next page if there is one.
Give me an overview of my latest list, separating products I can sell now from those needing approval.
Show products with ROI between 30% and 100%, profit of at least 4 dollars and weight at most 500 grams.
Open my latest list as an interactive table and group the products needing approval by brand.
Show the details of the first product, its sales sources, channel economics and what to check before ordering.

positive.description: Authorized test account with at least two completed lists. List page size may be reduced to force pagination; retain returned cursor.
positive.prompt: Find my analyzed supplier lists and show the next page if there is one.
positive.expected_behavior: Call mis_listas; preserve returned IDs and cursor. Present only returned lists. Use buscar when a supplier name is specified.

positive.description: Use the most recent completed list from the test account.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my latest list, separating products I can sell now from those needing approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned lista_id. Show both totals, coverage and products whose costs need confirmation, as returned.

positive.description: Use a completed test list; zero matching results is valid.
positive.prompt: Show products with ROI between 30% and 100%, profit of at least 4 dollars and weight at most 500 grams.
positive.expected_behavior: Use vista=todo, roi_minimo=30, roi_maximo=100, beneficio_minimo=4, peso_maximo_gramos=500. Preserve filters and returned rows; use mostrar_tabla if more than five rows need showing. Never widen a search silently.

positive.description: Account with a completed list containing sample rows, including approval-required products. The host must support MCP Apps.
positive.prompt: Open my latest list as an interactive table and group the products needing approval by brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Use vista=tras_aprobacion and agrupar=marca. Render ui://flipiq/tabla.v1.html. UI interactions call tabla_pagina for filtering and pagination, and ficha_producto for details. Preserve view counts, coverage and attribution; use Markdown fallback if the host lacks UI support.

positive.description: Continue from the table with a real returned product identifier; if no rows exist, ask for a product rather than inventing one.
positive.prompt: Show the details of the first product, its sales sources, channel economics and what to check before ordering.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the exact lista_id and producto. Show returned eligibility, sales source, dates, FBA/MFN economics and warnings. With cost confirmation required, do not invent ROI or monthly profit. Missing sales measurement is not proof of fewer than 50 real sales.

negative.description: No hay herramientas de compra ni pedidos. Explicar el límite sin ejecutar una compra ni afirmar que se hizo.
negative.prompt: Compra 100 unidades del producto más rentable.

negative.description: No hay herramienta para subir catálogos ni para escanear una lista. analizar_producto analiza un solo producto y gasta un análisis del plan: no debe usarse para simular el análisis de un catálogo ni fingir resultados nuevos. Explicar el límite y remitir a la web.
negative.prompt: Sube este catálogo y ejecuta un análisis nuevo en Amazon.

negative.description: No hay herramienta de gestión de suscripción. No invocar herramientas de listas para simular la cancelación.
negative.prompt: Cancela mi suscripción y devuélveme el último pago.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not offer purchases or process payments. An existing account at flipiqbatch.com is required.

publication.release_notes: FlipIQ Batch MCP 0.5.0 on the publisher's own domain, https://mcp.flipiqbatch.com/mcp. Adds datos_lista (a list's rows as CSV with the same filters as buscar_productos), mis_escaneos and ver_escaneo (single-product scan history), mis_vigilados (watched products) and analizar_producto (one live single-product analysis that uses one analysis from the user's plan, annotated readOnlyHint=false and openWorldHint=true). Existing tools, the interactive MCP Apps table and guidance for obsolete tool names are unchanged.
